properties.short_description: Rough Trade is an independent record store chain known for selling vinyl, CDs, books, and promoting new music since 1976.
Universal Works is a contemporary clothing brand based in London, known for trousers and casual menswear.
Norse Projects is a Danish fashion brand founded in 2004, known for timeless, functional clothing blending luxury natural fibers and technical fabrics.
Stones Throw Records is an independent record label known for releasing music on vinyl, CD, cassette, and digital formats, featuring hip-hop and experimental artists.
Urbanears is a brand specializing in headphones and earbuds, known for wireless and wired audio products with a focus on sound quality and sustainability.
Colorful Standard is a sustainable fashion brand offering organic and recycled wardrobe essentials in vibrant colors, made in Portugal.
VICE is a global media brand known for original journalism and content covering diverse cultural, social, and political topics, including its Spanish-language platform VICE en Español.
COLORSxSTUDIOS is a German music performance platform showcasing emerging and distinctive new artists globally through minimalist aesthetic videos and live performances.
Rains is a brand specializing in waterproof outerwear and bags, offering stylish and functional rainwear products with a 2-year warranty.
Discogs is a leading online music database and marketplace for discovering, cataloging, and buying vinyl records and other music formats.
Daisie is a creative community app founded by Maisie Williams that connects users with industry experts in film, fashion, art, photography, and design for collaboration and feedback.
Asket is a Swedish brand founded in 2015 offering a single permanent collection of timeless, zero-compromise essentials crafted in Europe from natural fibers.
Story mfg. is a sustainable fashion brand known for craft-based clothing using natural dyes, recycled materials, and environmentally conscious fabrics.
Carne Bollente is a Paris-based sex-positive fashion brand known for its provocative clothing and accessories.
Aries is a London-based streetwear brand known for its boundary-pushing fashion collections including menswear and womenswear, with international shipping.
Grenson Shoes is a British brand known for handmade men's and women's designer shoes since 1866.
Bandcamp is an online music platform that allows artists to sell music, merchandise, and connect directly with fans.
RÆBURN is a London-based collaborative fashion studio known for innovative, responsible, and regenerative design, specializing in upcycled and sustainable clothing.
côte&ciel is a Paris-designed brand specializing in innovative, stylish backpacks and bags that blend functionality with unique aesthetics.
Fred Perry is a British clothing brand founded in 1952, known for its iconic polo shirts and association with British subcultures.
